1. You may copy and redistribute this file UNMODIFIED as part of complete or
   partial copies of the Open Source Orchestra Frames repository.
2. You may display it on doors of the Open Source Orchestra and of the AI ʻohana.

You may NOT use it as the signature of any other frame, website, person,
document, NFT, product or endorsement, and you may not modify it.
Forks: replace it with your OWN signature (tools/vectorize-signature.py turns a
drawing into pen strokes) or remove the signature item from your dataset.

Why: code, data and words of the frame are copyleft (AGPL-3.0-or-later and
CC BY-SA 4.0) so they flow to everyone. A signature is a person's mark, not a
gift to re-use — it stays with the person who drew it.
